nodes.label: Python Requirements
nodes.rationale: pyvesc is installed from GitHub master rather than the PyPI 1.0.5 release because the release lacks the high-level VESC class, Alive, SetHandbrake and the modern GetValues field layout.

nodes.label: Dyno Recording CSV Schema
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous streams are written as one row each with a 'source' column marking the fresh value while other columns carry the most recent reading, preserving every raw sample without resampling. Columns: timestamp, elapsed_s, source, rpm, torque_mnm, throttle_pct.

nodes.label: Sticky Setpoint Watchdog
nodes.rationale: The most recent command is re-sent at a fixed 50 Hz cadence so the VESC command watchdog never trips and the motor does not unexpectedly coast to a stop; a single background I/O thread owns the port to avoid the data corruption from concurrent writes.

nodes.label: Dead-man Throttle Control
nodes.rationale: Holding the up arrow commands 100% throttle only while held; releasing it, losing focus, or switching modes immediately snaps throttle back to 0% so the engine can never get stuck at part throttle if a key-release is missed.
